speaker: brannoc
text: Dwarven work. You'd never find it without a dwarf.

speaker: brannoc
text: Hollow. Like Mags's promises.

speaker: mags
text: Ooh, someone's been hiding the good stuff.

speaker: wren
text: The Ember reveals what is hidden.

speaker: wren
text: Even walls have secrets. Let's hope theirs are nicer than ours.

speaker: ilsevar
text: There's a draught behind it. It smells like the sea.

speaker: ilsevar
text: Fascinating masonry. Mags, stop licking it.

speaker: mags
text: Push it, Brannoc. Harder. ...See? Was that so difficult?

speaker: brannoc
text: You could help, you know.

speaker: brannoc
text: Up to my beard. Not up to my dignity.

speaker: brannoc
text: Dwarves don't float. We sink with style.

speaker: mags
text: It's up to my everything, thanks for asking.

speaker: wren
text: Keep the lantern dry!

speaker: wren
text: Cold. So cold. Ember, give me strength.

speaker: ilsevar
text: It's... warm? Never mind.

speaker: ilsevar
text: The water's listening. Don't say anything rude.

speaker: mags
text: Someone carry me. Brannoc. Not like that.

speaker: brannoc
text: Sit on my shoulders and stop wriggling.

speaker: brannoc
text: My grandfather's. Probably. Hand it over.

speaker: mags
text: Mine.

speaker: wren
text: A tenth of that goes to the Ember.

speaker: wren
text: Is it stealing if they're dead? ...Don't answer that.

speaker: ilsevar
text: Careful, it could be cursed. ...Fine, I'll hold it.

speaker: ilsevar
text: The runes say 'property of'. The rest is barnacles.

speaker: brannoc
text: That's dwarven. Technically, that's mine.

speaker: mags
text: Finders keepers, losers weepers, dwarves grumpers.

speaker: brannoc
text: Just a scratch. A big, gushing scratch.

speaker: brannoc
text: Tell my beard I loved it.

speaker: mags
text: I'd like a refund on this dungeon.

speaker: wren
text: Physician, heal thyself... quickly, please.

speaker: wren
text: My flame is guttering.

speaker: ilsevar
text: The water says it can make the pain stop. ...I'm fine.

speaker: ilsevar
text: Not now. I haven't finished my notes.

speaker: mags
text: Wren, I need your hands on me. Healing hands. HEALING.

speaker: brannoc
text: Ugly. Shall we?

speaker: mags
text: Big, slimy and coming straight at me. Story of my love life.

speaker: wren
text: Abomination! ...Do we have a plan?

speaker: wren
text: Ember, burn bright.

speaker: ilsevar
text: I want to study it. Preferably dead.

speaker: ilsevar
text: It knows my name. Why does it know my name?

speaker: mags
text: Brannoc, your cousin's here.

speaker: brannoc
text: I've seen worse. I've kissed worse.

speaker: brannoc
text: Are we waiting for the water to drain?

speaker: wren
text: Ember, grant me patience. And a chair.

speaker: ilsevar
text: Yes... I hear you. Wait, did someone speak?

speaker: ilsevar
text: Fine. More time for notes.

speaker: mags
text: If we're stopping, I'm checking everyone's pockets.

speaker: brannoc
text: Stop snoring, halfling. Wait, that was me.

speaker: mags
text: Aww, look at his little bread!

speaker: brannoc
text: That's my ancestors' bread, thief.

speaker: wren
text: It's eaten better than we have.

speaker: brannoc
text: Is that crab wearing my uncle's helm?

speaker: mags
text: Suits him better, honestly.

speaker: ilsevar
text: Hermit behaviour. Dwarven hermit.

speaker: wren
text: Leeches. Ember preserve us.

speaker: mags
text: Nobody's sucking anything of mine.

speaker: ilsevar
text: Medicinal, technically. Still no.

speaker: brannoc
text: Get it off! Not the beard!

speaker: mags
text: It's on my— don't look!

speaker: wren
text: Hold still. I'll burn it off.

speaker: ilsevar
text: It likes me. That's worse.

speaker: brannoc
text: The old larder. Gods, the smell.

speaker: mags
text: Mine now. All of it. Even the mould.

speaker: mags
text: Your turn up front, Brannoc. You've more face to spare.

speaker: wren
text: Something down here wants my light.

speaker: mags
text: Ow. Who keeps a fist where the knives go?

speaker: brannoc
text: Fists are free. Axes are better.

speaker: brannoc
text: That's... a Stonevow crest on him.

speaker: brannoc
text: Feel that draught? Something's still breathing for this place.

speaker: ilsevar
text: It hums louder when I'm standing in it.

speaker: mags
text: Tap the pointy end, Brannoc.
listenerText: I know which end is pointy.

speaker: wren
text: Red's for blood, blue's for magic. Tap and drink.

speaker: mags
text: Bag's on the bottom. Tap a thing to use it.

speaker: ilsevar
text: Tap my face if you want my numbers. Gently.

speaker: brannoc
text: Only the front two can swing. Drag a face to swap.

speaker: mags
text: Don't. Just... don't talk to me for a bit.

speaker: brannoc
text: These lamps burned forever. Who put them out?
listenerText: Someone who needed the fire more.

speaker: mags
text: It's getting louder. I hate that it's catchy.

speaker: brannoc
text: Barracks. Beds made, boots lined up. Proper.
listenerText: Whoever's in them is very quiet.

speaker: mags
text: Hang on, Tam. I'm coming, you idiot.

speaker: wren
text: The water's warm here. Like it's breathing.

speaker: mags
text: He counted the days. Course he did. He always counts.
listenerText: Then he was waiting for someone.

speaker: mags
text: Hobb? ...Hobb. Oh, no. We did that.
listenerText: The lever. We should have looked first.

speaker: brannoc
text: The nook's flooded. Whoever was in there...

speaker: wren
text: There. Something of ours, given back.

speaker: ilsevar
text: It's seen the light. It's coming to eat it.

speaker: wren
text: No oil to spare. But my ember won't go out. Not for this.

speaker: mags
text: Lamp oil. Dwarves kept it like other folk keep wine.
listenerText: We kept the wine too. Hands off.

speaker: brannoc
text: Down here the dark isn't empty. It's full.
listenerText: Then stay in my light, and stop leaning on me.

speaker: mags
text: Something's clinking in there. Could be treasure.

speaker: brannoc
text: A lamp room with no lamps. That's not thrift. That's a robbery.

speaker: wren
text: Handed over on purpose. Who takes a keep's light?
listenerText: Someone who needed it more than us.

speaker: brannoc
text: He capped the last one himself. Brave little thief.

speaker: ilsevar
text: Sunlight. I'd forgotten it was free.
listenerText: Nothing's free. Check under the beams.

speaker: brannoc
text: My grandfather lit that. You just pinched it out like a candle.
